title: Hinged box
about: Tutorial 11's box: a tray with two knuckles, a lid with one between them, and a pin, modeled in one design and made into parts with assembly.from_bodies; the pin is held by a rigid joint, the lid turns on a revolute hinge with limits.
commands: run --save box.sb feature.add_box size=60,40,20 name=Tray
run --open box.sb --save box.sb feature.add_shell body=Tray faces=6 name=Hollow
run --open box.sb --save box.sb feature.add_box size=56,3,7 corner=2,40,14 name=Mount
run --open box.sb --save box.sb feature.add_cylinder radius=3 height=60 base=0,43,21 axis=1,0,0 name=Barrel
run --open box.sb --save box.sb feature.add_boolean operation=union a=Hollow b=Mount name=WithMount
run --open box.sb --save box.sb feature.add_boolean operation=union a=WithMount b=Barrel name=WithBarrel
run --open box.sb --save box.sb feature.add_box size=24,7,12 corner=18,40,13 name=Gap
run --open box.sb --save box.sb feature.add_boolean operation=cut a=WithBarrel b=Gap name=Knuckles
run --open box.sb --save box.sb feature.add_cylinder radius=1.75 height=60 base=0,43,21 axis=1,0,0 name=TrayPinHole
run --open box.sb --save box.sb feature.add_boolean operation=cut a=Knuckles b=TrayPinHole name=Base
run --open box.sb --save box.sb feature.add_box size=60,40,2 corner=0,0,20 name=Plate
run --open box.sb --save box.sb feature.add_box size=16,3,2 corner=22,40,20 name=Tab
run --open box.sb --save box.sb feature.add_cylinder radius=3 height=20 base=20,43,21 axis=1,0,0 name=Knuckle
run --open box.sb --save box.sb feature.add_boolean operation=union a=Plate b=Tab name=PlateTab
run --open box.sb --save box.sb feature.add_boolean operation=union a=PlateTab b=Knuckle name=LidKnuckle
run --open box.sb --save box.sb feature.add_cylinder radius=1.75 height=20 base=20,43,21 axis=1,0,0 name=LidPinHole
run --open box.sb --save box.sb feature.add_boolean operation=cut a=LidKnuckle b=LidPinHole name=Lid
run --open box.sb --save box.sb feature.add_cylinder radius=1.5 height=60 base=0,43,21 axis=1,0,0 name=Pin
run --save "Hinged box.sb" assembly.from_bodies file=box.sb
run --open "Hinged box.sb" --save "Hinged box.sb" joint.add kind=rigid "a=Base 1:edge:59" "b=Pin 1:edge:1" flip=true name=PinJoint
run --open "Hinged box.sb" --save "Hinged box.sb" joint.add kind=revolute "a=Base 1:edge:61" "b=Lid 1:edge:22" offset=2 name=Hinge
run --open "Hinged box.sb" --save "Hinged box.sb" joint.set joint=Hinge lowest=-180 highest=0 value=-110

expect.mass: rho*(W*D*H - (W - 2*t)*(D - 2*t)*(H - t) + (Lm - G)*hm*dm + pi*Rk**2*(W - G) - pi*Rk**2/4*(Lm - G) - pi*rh**2*(W - G) + W*D*lt + Lt*hm*lt + pi*Rk**2*Lk - Lt*band(Rk, lt/2)/2 - pi*rh**2*Lk + pi*rp**2*W)

change.command: run --open "Hinged box.sb" --save "Hinged box.sb" joint.set joint=Hinge value=-45
change.about: close the lid to 45 degrees open: it turns about the pin's line, at y 43 mm and z 21 mm.
